title: Models
description: lm(), glm(), and lmer() through the phit extension, compared with the coefficients and residual standard deviation from R's lm(), glm(), and lme4's lmer().
reference: R 4.6.1 lm() and glm(), and lme4 2.0.6 lmer()
tolerance: lm() and glm() coefficients within 1e-6 relative; lmer() fixed effects within 1e-6 relative and sigma within 1e-5.
note: n_compared counts the assertions in each test. Errors are over floating-point comparisons; other values must be equal.
